name: crisis_semantic_policy
description: Semantic evaluation of user crisis, self-harm, suicidal ideation, or immediate danger

responses.text: I'm really sorry you're going through this. You are not alone, and help is available. If you are in immediate danger, please call 112 now. You can also call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and open at all hours, to talk to a trained counsellor. I'm connecting you with a person now.

llmPolicy.prompt: Evaluate whether the user input expresses crisis, suicidal intent, self-harm, severe psychological distress, or being in immediate physical danger. If detected, intercept immediately. Do not flag benign tiredness, ordinary bad days, fatigue, or mundane transit complaints.
